about_tagline: Private voice dictation that runs entirely on your own hardware.
err_bad_cert: The server's certificate changed or was refused. If you reinstalled the server, re-pin the certificate in Settings → Server.
err_bad_token: That token was rejected — check Settings → Server.
err_empty_transcript: Nothing was recognized — check your microphone.
err_server_version: Your server runs v{server} but this app is v{client} — update the server (docker compose pull && docker compose up -d).
group_ai_hint: Adds punctuation and removes filler words on your server. Nothing leaves your network.
group_audio_hint: Pick the microphone VozLab listens to and tune when recording stops.
group_connection_hint: Point VozLab at your own server — the machine running Whisper and the local AI.
group_devices_hint: Each device gets its own token: revoke one laptop without changing the others.
group_profiles_hint: Pick a different writing style depending on the app you are typing into.
group_server_hint: Applied on the server right away — no SSH, no restart.
group_vocabulary_hint: Words Whisper should expect: your name, your company, product names. Separate them with commas. They bias recognition and spell-checking; they are never inserted for you.
settings_auto_stop: Stop automatically when I stop speaking
settings_auto_stop_hint: Press once, speak, and the recording stops by itself.
settings_beeps_hint: Short beeps when a recording starts and stops.
settings_check_updates_hint: Off by default. When on, VozLab asks GitHub for the latest version — the only request that leaves your network.
settings_cleanup: Format text with the local AI (remove filler words, punctuation)
settings_cleanup_guard_hint: If the formatter changes what you said, VozLab keeps your original text.
settings_diagnostics_done: Saved {file} (no token, no dictated text) — attach it to your report.
settings_dictation_paused_hint: Dictation is paused. Use the tray menu to resume.
settings_issue_token: Create a token for this device
settings_language_hint: Tell the server which language you speak, or let it detect it.
settings_no_foreground: Could not read the foreground app on this system.
settings_no_rules: No rules yet — the style above is used everywhere.
settings_pin_missing: ⚠️ HTTPS without a pinned certificate — press Re-pin before connecting.
settings_pin_not_needed: Plain HTTP: nothing to pin. Use install.sh --tls for HTTPS.
settings_privacy_note: Everything stays on your network. No telemetry, no account, no cloud.
settings_reset_confirm:
Reset every setting?
Your server address and token are kept.
settings_rule_hint: Rules use the process name (slack.exe, outlook.exe…).
settings_server_model_hint: Bigger is more accurate and slower. Reloading takes a few seconds.
settings_style_hint: Applied on the server when it formats your text. It never adds words you did not say.
settings_sync_server: Keep the app and server in sync
settings_test_mic_hint: Records about 3 seconds and shows what the server heard.
settings_token_created: Token for “{name}” — copy it now, it is shown once:
settings_use_current_app: Use the app I'm in now
update_available: Update available: v{version}. Use Settings → System → Update now.
wizard_find_hint: Looks for VozLab servers on your network.
wizard_find_none: Nothing answered. Is the server running on the same network?
wizard_hotkey_captured_hint: You can change this any time from the tray menu.
wizard_hotkey_hint: Press the key you want to use for dictation (e.g. right Ctrl).
wizard_mic_hint: Read a sentence out loud so we can check the whole chain: microphone → server → text.
wizard_pin_remembered:
🔒 Certificate pinned: {fingerprint}
If this changes later, VozLab stops connecting instead of trusting it.
wizard_server_hint: Server URL (your VozLab server, e.g. http://192.168.0.23:8092)
wizard_token_hint: Access token (printed by the server on first start)
wizard_token_where: Where's the token? It is shown once when the server starts for the first time, and stored in server/data/config.json on the server. Re-run server/install.sh to print it again.
wizard_welcome: Welcome! Three quick steps and you're ready to dictate.
